extracted.name: French Toast Sticks
extracted.description: Perfect for an on-the-go breakfast, these kid-friendly French toast sticks are as easy to make as they are delicious!
ingredient_lines: 6 slices white bread, cut into thirds
instruction_lines: Mix eggs, powdered sugar, milk, maple syrup, brown sugar, and cinnamon together in a bowl with a fork until well blended.
Dip each bread stick into the egg mixture.

Coat a skillet with nonstick spray and heat over medium heat. Place sticks in the hot skillet and cook until brown, 2 to 3 minutes; turn over and cook until browned on other side, 2 to 3 minutes more.
